text: JasonTheWeen switched his console to New Zealand just for this. And then he lit a candle. For Lucia.
Then Lacy met Lucia. It was love at first sight… for about twenty seconds.
DarkViperAU had a plan: crash through the wall.
Quin69 went full stealth. For about ten seconds.
Then the game said he abandoned Donnie. He disagreed.
And Clix found out he'd never actually played on a controller.
TGG was very proud of his landing.
But JasonTheWeen saved the best for last.
